question: Should experimental Claw lifecycle ownership diagnostics be accepted as a core Doctor responsibility once the dependent lifecycle stack lands, or should this diagnostic remain outside core until a narrower owner boundary is approved?
rationale: The patch is a new cross-owner core diagnostic surface rather than a repair to an established Doctor contract; source-level correctness evidence cannot determine the intended long-term product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the core Doctor boundary
options.body: Accept the guarded core diagnostic after the dependent ownership stages are approved, with the experimental gate clearly documented.

options.title: Keep diagnostics out of core for now
options.body: Pause or close this stacked slice until maintainers choose an owner-specific or plugin-facing diagnostics boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core Doctor boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the guarded core diagnostic after the dependent ownership stages are approved, with the experimental gate clearly documented.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion explicitly routed attention to this person for the unresolved direction decision, though the available evidence does not establish formal ownership.
